battle.name: 第四次反法同盟
battle.brief: 第四次反法同盟期間，1806年10月，普魯士軍在奧爾施泰特迎戰法軍並遭敗北。交戰中，線列步兵仍以燧發槍（Flintlock musket）射擊，再配合刺刀近戰；此役為普法戰爭的重要戰鬥。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 第四次反法同盟並非在1806年秋天同時集結的單一聯軍，而是分階段形成的軍事安排。英國自1803年起已與法國交戰，1806年主要以海上封鎖、盟國補貼及波羅的海遠征支援普魯士和俄國。拿破崙要求法軍借道普魯士並進入安斯巴赫，普魯士朝廷認為主權與安全受侵，於9月動員並率先開戰。俄國此前已與普魯士締約，但集結兵力及越過涅曼河較慢，直到普魯士主力在十月遭毀後才完成戰略展開。瑞典於1807年參戰，拿破崙擊退俄軍後又迫使奧地利投入新的戰役。法方則有法國軍、萊茵邦聯各國部隊、受法軍指揮的波蘭部隊及若干外籍兵。戰線由圖林根、薩克斯與西里西亞伸向勃蘭登堡、波美拉尼亞、波蘭和東普魯士，並在戰事後期延伸到奧地利戰場；英國雖提供經費和海軍，卻始終沒有投入足以在德國取得決定性优势的陸軍主力。
countriesEn: The Fourth Coalition was not a single allied army that assembled simultaneously in the autumn of 1806; it developed in stages. Britain had already been at war with France since 1803 and supported Prussia and Russia in 1806 through naval blockade, subsidies, and expeditionary forces in the Baltic. Napoleon demanded passage through Prussian territory and entered Ansbach, where the Prussian government regarded its authority and security as violated, so Prussia mobilized in September and opened the war. Russia had already concluded an alliance with Prussia, but it assembled its armies and crossed the Niemen more slowly, completing its strategic deployment only after the Prussian field army had been destroyed in October. Sweden entered the war in 1807, while Russian defeats eventually drove Napoleon to force Austria to intervene again. On the French side were the armies of France, contingents from the Confederation of the Rhine, Polish troops under French command, and several foreign units. The theaters extended from Thuringia, Saxony, and Silesia through Brandenburg, Pomerania, Poland, and East Prussia, and later into Austria. Britain supplied money and naval power but never deployed a land force large enough to decide the campaign in Germany.
people: 戰局首先取決於普魯士指揮體系的失誤。國王腓特烈威廉三世雖調集多個軍團，卻沒有讓布倫斯威克公爵集中全部兵力便令其展開攻勢；公爵陣亡後，失去統一指揮的普軍各縱隊在耶拿與奧爾施泰特分別覆沒。布呂歇爾率後衛在西面牽制俄軍方向，卻未能改變本國主力崩潰的結果。拿破崙一面以近衛軍和各軍團迅速壓迫，一面讓達武的第三軍獨立北進，使這支部隊在奧爾施泰特以師級縱隊構成防線，頂住普軍集中攻擊；莫蒂耶、拉納與內伊所部則在縱深追擊和封鎖退路。俄軍總司令本尼先森的處置較為反覆，他屢次等待盟軍、掩護後方並轉移主力，既保住部分軍隊，也使各軍團長時間分處不同方向。巴格拉季翁在後衛戰中保持較完整的指揮，拉古夫斯卡則在弗里德蘭直接控制防線核心。波那托夫斯基指揮波軍參加普爾圖斯克作戰。內伊的第六軍在弗里德蘭開戰初期未能及時趕到，格拉希的騎兵預備隊則在決定性衝鋒中挽回部分步兵攻勢。英國遠征軍由克勞福德率領，雖以第九十五步槍團在波美拉尼亞建立據點，兵力仍不足以改變北方戰局。
peopleEn: The campaign first turned on mistakes in the Prussian command system. King Frederick William III assembled several corps but did not allow Duke Frederick William of Brunswick to concentrate the whole army before offensive operations began. After the duke was killed, the disconnected Prussian columns were defeated separately at Jena and Auerstedt. Blücher’s rear guard exerted pressure in the west but could not change the collapse of the main Prussian army. Napoleon combined rapid movement by the Guard and several corps with the independent northward movement of Davout’s III Corps. At Auerstedt, Davout formed a division-level defensive line that absorbed the concentrated Prussian attack, while Mortier, Lannes, and Ney pursued the defeated formations and closed their routes of retreat. Russian commander Levin August von Bennigsen acted indecisively, repeatedly waiting for allied forces, covering withdrawals, and shifting the main army. This preserved part of the Russian force but also kept its corps separated. Bagration retained a comparatively coherent command during rear-guard actions, and Raevsky controlled the central defensive position at Friedland. Poniatowski commanded Polish forces at Pultusk. Ney’s VI Corps did not arrive in time for the opening of Friedland, while Grouchy’s cavalry reserve helped recover part of the infantry attack. Britain’s expedition under Robert Craufurd established a foothold in Pomerania with the 95th Rifles, but it was too small to alter the northern campaign.
kits: 1806年的野戰裝備仍以火槍、定裝彈與輕型野戰炮為核心。法國步兵使用夏爾勒維爾1777式單發燧膛步槍，士兵由隨身藥盒攜帶火藥與彈丸，營、旅及軍團後方再以彈藥車補充；1807年才開始換發的安 Ninth 式火槍不應出現在耶拿、艾勞或弗里德蘭。法國炮兵使用格里博瓦爾制四磅輕炮及六磅野戰炮，炮組備有已裝待發的彈藥和由炮車載運的備份彈藥。輕騎使用1796式軍刀，胸甲騎兵、驃龍騎兵與波蘭籍騎兵配各自的頭盔、馬具、馬刀或騎槍，方頂波蘭帽也是當時實際使用的裝備。普魯士步兵主要使用沿用舊有制度的波茨坦式長身燧膛火槍，其後端照門便於射擊；野戰炮包括三磅與六磅炮，Jäger使用獵槍。俄軍步兵裝備制式燧膛滑膛步槍與插座刺刀，炮兵主要使用六磅及十二磅野戰炮。英國第九十五步槍團使用1800年定型的貝克式步槍，並配英國六磅野戰炮。普魯士、俄國與英軍同樣依靠藥盒、射手彈袋、營屬彈藥箱和後方彈藥車維持供應。弗里德蘭跨越阿勒河時，法軍工程兵攜帶 pontoon 舟具和可拆裝橋件，在夜裡逐點架橋，並未等待從遠方運來的固定桥梁。
kitsEn: The field equipment of 1806 centered on muskets, prepared ammunition, and light field artillery. French infantry carried the single-shot Charleville Model 1777 flintlock musket, with powder and ball carried in the soldier’s cartridge box and replenishment supplied by brigade, division, and corps trains. The Model An IX musket, whose replacement process began only in 1807, did not equip the armies at Jena, Eylau, or Friedland. French artillery used Gribeauval-system four-pounder light guns and six-pounder field pieces, with loaded rounds and reserve ammunition carried by the gun teams and limbers. Light cavalry used the Model 1796 saber, while cuirassiers, dragoons, and Polish cavalry had their own helmets, tack, swords, and lances; the square-topped Polish czapka was also in service. Prussian infantry generally carried the long-barreled Potsdam flintlock musket, whose rear sight assisted aiming, while field artillery included three- and six-pounder guns and the Jäger carried hunting rifles. Russian infantry were armed with standard flintlock smoothbore muskets and socket bayonets, and their artillery relied chiefly on six- and twelve-pounder field guns. The British 95th Rifles carried the Baker rifle adopted in 1800 and were supported by British six-pounder field artillery. Prussian, Russian, and British troops likewise drew ammunition from cartridge boxes, individual ammunition pouches, unit supply chests, and trains. At Friedland, French engineers carried pontoon boats and sectional bridge equipment, assembling crossings at several places during the night instead of waiting for a permanent bridge to arrive from a distant depot.
tactics: 法軍沒有讓全軍在同一正面連續作戰，而是以軍團和師的距離分別行軍，再在指定會合點集中。普軍三路出發後，縱隊之間距離過大，公爵卻在未掌握達武第三軍所在位置的情況下進攻。施萊茨與薩爾菲爾德接觸後，內伊的縱隊在城鎮附近以師線應戰，普軍在起伏地和狹窄道路上屢次改變方向，密集縱隊因此難以一次投入。耶拿戰役中，拿破崙以多路師縱隊穿過道路、田野和村落，從普軍翼側與正面同時施壓，迫使普軍在通信中斷和指揮分散下逐次退出陣地。奧爾施泰特則呈現相反情況：達武缺少騎兵，仍把三個師配置在阿爾施泰特、霍恩羅德與維特斯多夫一帶，以鄉間道路、房屋和砲兵射程構成相互支援的防線；普軍步兵屢次接近炮口仍未打穿整條陣線，騎兵衝鋒也因速度不足和火力的支線射擊而失敗。俄軍轉戰波蘭後，以巴格拉季翁率後衛掩護主力反覆撤退，並利用阿里奧河、維斯圖拉河支流、森林和村落製造遲滯。普爾圖斯克戰中，波軍步兵曾渡過納雷夫河並奪取橋頭堡，但俄軍反擊迫使法軍退過河岸。登彭與海爾斯貝格作戰都顯示法軍若把縱隊過早投入，常被俄軍據點和後衛逐退。弗里德蘭最完整地呈現法軍的協同：工程兵先在阿勒河上游架橋，莫蒂耶與拉納的步兵在天亮後佔領俄軍外圍據點，炮兵向前展開，以近距離實心彈和霰彈壓制斜坡上的俄軍縱隊。貝尼先森把右岸部分部隊調往左岸後，右翼變薄；內伊到達後立即威脅缺口，拉納正面衝破防线。俄軍仍以縱隊反衝，但法軍騎兵預備隊反覆衝鋒，最終迫使本尼先森向東普魯士撤退。
tacticsEn: The French did not fight continuously on a single front with the entire army. They marched corps and divisions separately and concentrated at designated meeting points. After the Prussians had launched three columns, the distance between them became too great, while the duke attacked before determining Davout’s position. At Schleiz and Saalfeld, Ney’s divisions met the Prussians near towns and broken ground; changing directions on narrow roads and among slopes prevented the dense Prussian columns from being committed together. At Jena, several French divisions advanced through roads, fields, and villages against both the front and flank of the Prussian position. Disrupted communications and divided command caused the Prussians to leave one line of battle after another. Auerstedt produced the opposite situation. Although Davout lacked cavalry, he positioned three divisions around Auerstedt, Hohenrod, and Wittersdorf. Houses, lanes, and interlocking fields of fire formed a mutually supporting line. Prussian infantry repeatedly approached the guns without breaking the whole position, and cavalry charges failed because of insufficient speed and enfilading fire. After entering Poland, Russia used Bagration’s rear guard to delay the main retreat while woods, villages, the Alle, and branches of the Vistula broke up French pursuit. At Pultusk, Polish troops crossed the Narew and seized a bridgehead, but a Russian counterattack forced them back across the river. The fighting at Deppen and Heilsberg showed that French columns committed too early could be checked by prepared positions and rearguards. Friedland was the clearest demonstration of combined French operations. Engineers bridged the upper Alle during the night, and Mortier’s and Lannes’s troops occupied Russian outposts before dawn. Artillery advanced to fire at close range with round shot and canister into the Russian columns on the slope. Bennigsen moved troops from the eastern bank to strengthen the left, exposing his right. On Ney’s arrival, the threat to that flank intensified while Lannes broke the front. Russian counterattacks remained disordered, and repeated charges by the French cavalry reserve finally drove Bennigsen toward East Prussia.
data: 1806年9月28日，德國境內最初的主要接觸發生在施萊茨，普軍前衛與法軍先頭部隊交戰後退往圖林根。10月10日，薩爾菲爾德戰役開始，布倫斯威克公爵率部攻擊內伊縱隊，公爵陣亡，海塞的路易親王亦受重傷。10月14日，拿破崙主力在耶拿擊潰由公爵指揮的普軍主力，達武第三軍則同日守住奧爾施泰特；10月17日的哈勒戰役又使法軍一個師團被迫撤往南部城鎮。普軍崩潰後，拿破崙把作戰分為追擊、佔領和攻堅三條線。呂貝克於11月4日投降，什切青在11月16日 capitulation，丹澤克經一個多月進攻後於11月29日 capitulation。俄軍先由布克斯赫維登率先頭越過涅曼河，經格羅德諾向東普魯士推進，主力則集結於阿倫施泰因、奧斯特羅德和古特施塔特一帶。10月的雨使道路泥濘，普軍縱隊與後方彈藥車被拉開；11月至翌年2月則出現短日照、結冰和反覆融雪，影響行軍和糧食運輸。12月20日至21日，本尼先森的後衛在戈利明阻擋法軍前進，掩護主力完成撤退。格拉登茨在1807年1月投降，科爾貝格經長期抵抗後於2月投降，這些據點迫使法軍留下圍攻分遣隊。5月26日，拿破崙在普爾圖斯克渡過納雷夫河後攻入俄軍橋頭堡，因俄軍反擊和法軍指揮失序而退回西岸。6月5日至6日，登彭戰役中內伊擊破俄軍後衛並奪取火炮。6月10日，法軍在海爾斯貝格逼近俄軍堡壘線，阿勒河橋梁被破壞，俄軍利用正面火力逐次退出。6月14日，莫蒂耶與拉納在弗里德蘭上游渡過阿勒河，拿破崙隨即把炮兵和步兵推向本尼先森左翼，骑兵戰至午後後迫使俄軍向陶魯普方向退卻。拿破崙隨後進入但澤、哥尼斯堡一帶並開始外交談判；法軍主力則不得不同時應付7月重新開戰的奧地利軍，於7月5日至6日在瓦格拉姆擊敗其主力。7月7日，法國、俄國與普魯士在涅曼河上的蒂爾西特簽約，北方戰事至此取得政治結論。
dataEn: The first substantial contact inside Germany occurred at Schleiz on 28 September 1806, when the Prussian advanced guard engaged the French vanguard and withdrew toward Thuringia. Fighting began at Saalfeld on 10 October when Duke Frederick William of Brunswick attacked Ney’s corps. The duke was killed and Prince Louis of Hesse was mortally wounded. On 14 October, Napoleon’s main force destroyed the principal army under the duke at Jena, while Davout’s III Corps held Auerstedt the same day. At the Battle of Halle on 17 October, a French division was then forced to withdraw toward the southern towns. After the Prussian collapse, Napoleon divided operations into pursuit, occupation, and siege. Lübeck capitulated on 4 November, Stettin on 16 November, and Danzig on 29 November after more than a month of resistance. Buxhoeveden led the Russian advance across the Niemen through Grodno, while Bennigsen’s main body assembled around Allenstein, Osterode, and Guttstadt. Rain in October turned roads to mud and separated the Prussian columns from their ammunition vehicles. From November into February, short daylight, frost, and repeated thaws complicated movement and supply. Bennigsen’s rearguard delayed the French at Golymin on 20 and 21 December while covering the withdrawal of the main army. Graudenz surrendered in January 1807, and Kolberg capitulated in February after a prolonged resistance, forcing the French to detach blockade and siege troops. On 26 May, Napoleon crossed the Narew at Pultusk and entered Bennigsen’s bridgehead, but Russian counterattacks and French command confusion forced a retreat to the western bank. At Deppen on 5 and 6 June, Ney broke the Russian rearguard and captured guns. At Heilsberg on 10 June, the Russians removed a crossing of the Alle and used a prepared defensive line to withdraw in sequence. On 14 June, Mortier and Lannes crossed the upper Alle at Friedland. Napoleon moved artillery and infantry against Bennigsen’s left, and cavalry fighting forced the Russians back toward Taurupp. Napoleon subsequently entered the vicinity of Danzig and Königsberg and opened negotiations, while part of the French army had to face Austria, which had resumed the war, and defeated its principal army at Wagram on 5 and 6 July. On 7 July, France, Russia, and Prussia signed the Treaties of Tilsit on the Neman, providing the political conclusion to the northern campaign.
cause: 戰爭的直接原因，是法國在建立萊茵邦聯、改造法屬德國地區並擴張波蘭控制之後，破壞了普魯士原先設想的均勢。拿破崙不能容忍普魯士拒絕結盟或限制法軍通行，因此以軍隊進入安斯巴赫和借道要求迫使普魯士選擇；普國朝廷則擔心西線失守後失去西里西亞通道，並認為讓法軍自由通過會使國家安全受制於巴黎。英國早已希望重建普俄合作，以海軍壓制法國貿易，再用補貼承擔遠征軍費用。俄國願與普魯士共同遏制法國，但關切集中在波蘭、法軍駐紮與奧地利重新強大，最初採取觀望和慢速動員，結果使普軍先行承擔全部壓力。瑞典參戰是因丹麥與法國軍隊對瑞典波美拉尼亞構成直接威脅；奧地利則在俄軍即將失敗時看到法國仍可支配中部歐洲，因而再次開戰。拿破崙的基本目標，是在俄國完成集結前先摧毀普軍，再迫使俄國接受法國在波蘭、萊茵地區和德國的安排。戰爭最深的失敗並非英俄沒有共同敵人，而是三國沒有共同時間表：普魯士過早攻擊，俄國推進過慢，英國海上封鎖無法直接阻止法軍在歐陸集中。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was the destruction of the balance of power that Prussia had expected to preserve after France reorganized the Rhineland, expanded its influence within Germany, and increased its control in Poland. Napoleon would not tolerate a Prussian refusal to ally or restrict the movement of French troops. He therefore used the occupation of Ansbach and demands for free passage to force a decision. The Prussian government feared that a failure in the west would threaten its access to Silesia and that unrestricted French passage would subordinate national security to Paris. Britain had long sought to restore Prussian-Russian cooperation, using the navy to pressure French trade while subsidies paid for expeditionary forces. Russia agreed to join Prussia in containing France, but its immediate concern was the French position in Poland, the French armies stationed there, and the possible recovery of Austrian power. Its caution and slow mobilization left Prussia to bear the first full weight of the campaign. Sweden entered because Danish and French forces threatened Swedish Pomerania. Austria waited until Russia was close to collapse, judged that France could still dominate central Europe, and entered the war again. Napoleon’s central purpose was to destroy the Prussian army before Russia completed mobilization, then force acceptance of French arrangements in Poland, the Rhineland, and Germany. The fundamental coalition failure was not the absence of a common enemy, but the absence of a common timetable. Prussia attacked too early, Russia advanced too slowly, and the British blockade could not directly prevent France from concentrating its forces on the continent.
impact: 耶拿與奧爾施泰特首先改變了整個戰爭的力量結構。普魯士大部分野戰軍在一周內失去戰鬥能力，國王退回東普魯士，原先計畫中的普俄會攻變成俄軍獨自對抗法軍。施泰因、施恩霍斯特和格奈森瑙等仍保有經驗的軍官後來重整軍隊，使普魯士軍事改革與戰敗直接相連。法軍雖取得戰略主動權，卻必須留下分遣隊監視和攻取普魯士要塞，並沿波蘭道路追擊俄軍，因此戰線越過里加後仍受到河流、彈藥車和縱隊距離限制。英國遠征軍在波美拉尼亞取得據點，卻無法切斷法軍與波蘭之間的主要道路，也沒有力量迫使拿破崙停止攻勢。巴格拉季翁等游擊與後衛戰延期了俄軍崩潰，卻沒有扭轉列寧格勒方向持續後退的整體趨勢。弗里德蘭結束了本季決定性會戰：俄軍仍保有可以重建的部隊，卻失去在波蘭平原主動再戰的能力。此後法國控制建立波蘭軍團所需的樞紐，奧地利失去再次集結的時間，而普魯士則被迫接受大幅削弱軍力與外交力量的安排。戰役同時暴露法軍的另一項限制：連續勝利使其指揮鏈拉得過長，遠征縱隊和攻城分遣隊越多，前方主力可調用的力量越少。俄國雖在蒂爾西特求和，其軍隊和戰略條件仍然存在，後續法俄衝突的根因並未因預備和奧爾施泰特兩戰而消失。
impactEn: Jena and Auerstedt first transformed the balance of power in the war. Most of the Prussian field army lost its fighting capacity within a week. The king withdrew to East Prussia, and the planned Prusso-Russian invasion turned into a Russian struggle against France alone. Experienced officers such as Stein, Scharnhorst, and Gneisenau survived and later rebuilt the army, directly linking military reform to the defeat. France gained the strategic initiative but had to detach troops to watch and reduce Prussian fortresses while pursuing the Russians through Poland. Beyond the Vistula, rivers, supply wagons, and the length of the marching columns continued to limit the French advance. The British expedition gained a foothold in Pomerania but could neither cut the main road between France and Poland nor compel Napoleon to stop. Bagration’s rear-guard actions delayed Russia’s collapse, but did not alter the general retreat toward Königsberg. Friedland ended the decisive campaign of that season. Russia still retained forces with which to rebuild, but could no longer initiate an open campaign in the Polish plain. France acquired the territorial basis needed to organize Polish divisions. Austria lost time to mobilize again, and Prussia was forced to accept arrangements that severely reduced its military and diplomatic position. The campaign also exposed a limit of French success. Continuous victories stretched the command structure; the more detached expeditionary columns and siege forces existed, the fewer troops the leading army could concentrate. Russia sought peace at Tilsit, but its army and strategic problems survived the victories at Preussisch Eylau and Heilsberg, leaving the basis for a later Franco-Russian conflict intact.
result: 弗里德蘭之後，本尼先森放棄在波蘭平原繼續決戰，退往東普魯士；普魯士政府也無法維持獨立作戰，轉而尋求停戰。法軍主力南下，於7月5日至6日在瓦格拉姆擊敗重新開戰的奧地利軍，迫使維也納承認軍事失敗。7月7日，拿破崙與亞歷山大一世在涅曼河中央的堤爾西特會談，法國、俄國和普魯士分別簽訂條約。普魯士交出易北河以西的大部分領土及在波蘭取得的政治地位，接受法國對萊茵邦聯和新波蘭安排，並支付賠款、提供軍隊配合封鎖及限制未來軍力。俄國承認法國在德國和波蘭造成的制度變動，停止對英國作戰配合並答應調解英法關係；俄軍則撤出主要戰線，保留未受占領的本土與重建軍隊的能力。瑞典方面也以單獨安排結束北方式的戰事，奧地利在瓦格拉姆後於10月簽訂申布倫和約。蒂爾西特沒有消除英國的海上力量，也沒有使英國承認法國在歐洲的地位，所以第四次反法同盟在歐陸失敗後，戰爭仍以英法衝突的形式繼續。法國取得的是決定性的歐陸優勢，而非全面和平；普魯士軍事力量受重創但未被消滅，俄國被迫退讓但仍保存國家實力，奧地利與瑞典的再介入均告失敗。這就是從1806年普魯士動員到1807年瓦格拉姆、蒂爾西特與申布倫和約的完整結果。
resultEn: After Friedland, Bennigsen abandoned the attempt to continue the decisive struggle in the Polish plain and withdrew toward East Prussia. The Prussian government could no longer continue the war independently and sought an armistice. The main French army moved south, defeated the Austrian army when it resumed hostilities at Wagram on 5 and 6 July, and forced Vienna to accept military defeat. On 7 July, Napoleon and Alexander I met at Tilsit in the middle of the Neman, where France, Russia, and Prussia concluded separate treaties. Prussia ceded most of its territories west of the Elbe and relinquished its political position in Poland, accepted the French arrangements for the Confederation of the Rhine and the new Polish state, paid an indemnity, provided troops for the blockade, and accepted limits on its future military strength. Russia recognized the French institutional changes in Germany and Poland, ended military cooperation against Britain, and agreed to mediate between France and London. Russian forces withdrew from the main theater while preserving their homeland and the capacity to rebuild the army. Sweden ended the northern fighting through a separate arrangement, while Austria concluded the Peace of Schönbrunn in October after its defeat at Wagram. Tilsit neither destroyed British sea power nor forced London to recognize French predominance in Europe. After the continental members of the Fourth Coalition were defeated, the war continued as a struggle between Britain and France. France obtained decisive continental predominance rather than a general peace. Prussia’s military power was shattered but not eliminated, Russia accepted defeat while preserving its state and army, and the renewed interventions by Austria and Sweden both failed. This was the full outcome of the campaign, from the Prussian mobilization of 1806 through Wagram and the Treaties of Tilsit and Schönbrunn in 1807.
